title: 第14章 搬救兵2-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》
content:
第(1/3)页

    王老板夫妇脸上虽然依旧满是失望，却也没有过多抱怨。

    他们心里清楚，自己已经请了不少高人，连清源山的道长都败在了女鬼手下，吴姜这么年轻，能和女鬼打成平手，还能全身而退，已经超出了他们的预料，眼下，也只能相信吴姜了。

    吴姜又开口叮嘱道：“你们今晚最好别待在这栋别墅里了，先去外面躲一躲，等我解决了女鬼，再给你们打电话，到时候你们再回来。”

    “这……”王老板面露犹豫，眼神下意识地看向二楼。

    他实在放不下床上昏睡的儿子，放心不下把他一个人留在这栋闹鬼的别墅里。

    “积友啊，听小姜的吧。”老爷子见状，连忙开口劝说，“你们留在这儿也帮不上什么忙，反而可能会拖累小姜，万一激怒了那女鬼，反而对小寻不利。”

    老爷子的话，终究还是起了作用。

    王老板咬了咬牙，点了点头，下定决心说道：“好，我们听小姜的。我们家在城东还有一套别墅，平时没人住，我们先去那里躲一晚。”

    吴姜在一旁暗自咋舌：果然是土豪，随手就能拿出另一套别墅，这实力，真是让人羡慕。

    既然已经决定，众人也不再犹豫，快速拿上随身的必要物品，跟着王老板，驱车前往他位于城东的另一套别墅。

    刚一抵达别墅，吴姜就立刻开口说道：“王叔叔，给我找个安静的房间，我要施法通阴，联系救兵，不能有人打扰。”

    “好，好，跟我来！”王老板连忙点头，不敢有丝毫耽搁，连忙领着吴姜上了二楼。

    王老板将吴姜领到客房门口，又仔细询问了一遍，确认吴姜不需要其他东西，这才转身下了楼。

    此刻，他所有的希望，都寄托在了吴姜身上，哪怕心里依旧没底，也只能选择相信。

    老爷子没有跟着下楼，而是打算守在客房门口，陪着吴姜，生怕有人不小心打扰到他。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Although the faces of Boss Wang and his wife were still full of disappointment, they did not complain too much.

They knew in their hearts that they had invited many experts, and even the Taoist Priest of Qingyuan Mountain was defeated by the female ghost. Wu Jiang, who was so young, could fight to a draw with the female ghost and escape unscathed was beyond their expectations. At the moment, they could only believe Wu Jiang.

Wu Jiang warned again: "You'd better not stay in this villa tonight. Go hide outside first. I'll call you after I deal with the female ghost. Then you can come back."

"This..." Boss Wang hesitated and looked subconsciously towards the second floor.

He really couldn’t let go of his sleeping son on the bed, and couldn’t bear to leave him alone in this haunted villa.

"Jiyou, listen to Xiao Jiang." Seeing this, the old man quickly tried to persuade him, "You guys can't help much by staying here. Instead, it might drag down Xiao Jiang. If the female ghost is angered, it will be detrimental to Xiao Xun."

The old man’s words worked after all.

Boss Wang gritted his teeth, nodded, and made up his mind and said, "Okay, let's listen to Xiao Jiang. Our family also has a villa in the east of the city, which is usually unoccupied. Let's go there to hide for one night."

Wu Jiang was secretly stunned at the side: He is indeed a rich man, and he can easily take out another villa. This strength is really enviable.

Now that they have decided, everyone no longer hesitates, quickly grabs the necessary belongings, follows Boss Wang, and drives to his other villa in the east of the city.

As soon as he arrived at the villa, Wu Jiang immediately said: "Uncle Wang, find me a quiet room. I want to cast a spell to unblock the yin and contact the reinforcements. No one can disturb me."

"Okay, okay, follow me!" Boss Wang nodded quickly, not daring to delay at all, and quickly led Wu Jiang to the second floor.

Boss Wang led Wu Jiang to the door of the guest room, asked carefully again, and confirmed that Wu Jiang did not need anything else, then turned and went downstairs.

At this moment, all his hopes were placed on Wu Jiang. Even if he was still unsure, he could only choose to believe.

The old man did not follow him downstairs, but planned to stay at the door of the guest room to accompany Wu Jiang, for fear that someone would accidentally disturb him.
